proofTerm:
by
  intro a ha1 hrec n hn
  have source_step_0 : 0 < a 1 ∧ a 1 < 2 := by
    all_goals rw [ha1]
    all_goals norm_num
  have source_step_1 : ∀ n : ℕ, 1 ≤ n → 0 < a n ∧ a n < 2 → 0 < a (n + 1) := by
    intro m hm hb
    have hden : 0 < a m + 2 := by linarith [hb.1]
    have hnum : 0 < 3 * a m + 2 := by linarith [hb.1]
    all_goals rw [hrec m hm]
    exact div_pos hnum hden
  have source_step_2 : ∀ m : ℕ, 1 ≤ m → 0 < a m ∧ a m < 2 →
      (2 - a (m + 1) = (2 - a m) / (a m + 2)) ∧ 0 < 2 - a (m + 1) := by
    intro m hm hb
    have hden : 0 < a m + 2 := by linarith [hb.1]
    have hneq : a m + 2 ≠ 0 := ne_of_gt hden
    have heq : 2 - a (m + 1) = (2 - a m) / (a m + 2) := by
      all_goals rw [hrec m hm]
      field_simp [hneq]
      all_goals ring
    have hpos : 0 < 2 - a (m + 1) := by
      all_goals rw [heq]
      exact div_pos (by linarith [hb.2]) hden
    exact ⟨heq, hpos⟩
  have source_step_3 : ∀ m : ℕ, 1 ≤ m → 0 < a m ∧ a m < 2 := by
    have hbound : ∀ k : ℕ, 0 < a (k + 1) ∧ a (k + 1) < 2 := by
      intro k
      induction k with
      | zero =>
          simpa using source_step_0
      | succ k ih =>
          have hm : 1 ≤ k + 1 := by omega
          have hpos : 0 < a ((k + 1) + 1) := source_step_1 (k + 1) hm ih
          have hlt : 0 < 2 - a ((k + 1) + 1) := (source_step_2 (k + 1) hm ih).2
          have hpos2 : 0 < a (Nat.succ k + 1) := by
            simpa [Nat.succ_eq_add_one, Nat.add_assoc] using hpos
          have hlt2 : a (Nat.succ k + 1) < 2 := by
            have hlt' : a ((k + 1) + 1) < 2 := by linarith
            simpa [Nat.succ_eq_add_one, Nat.add_assoc] using hlt'
          exact ⟨hpos2, hlt2⟩
    intro m hm
    cases m with
    | zero => omega
    | succ k =>
        simpa [Nat.succ_eq_add_one] using hbound k
  let b : ℕ → ℝ := fun m => (2 - a m) / (a m + 1)
  have source_step_4 : ∀ m : ℕ, 1 ≤ m → b m = (2 - a m) / (a m + 1) := by
    intro m hm
    rfl
  have source_step_5 : ∀ m : ℕ, 1 ≤ m → 0 < a m + 1 := by
    intro m hm
    have hp : 0 < a m := (source_step_3 m hm).1
    all_goals linarith
  have source_step_6 : ∀ m : ℕ, 1 ≤ m → 2 - a (m + 1) = (2 - a m) / (a m + 2) := by
    intro m hm
    exact (source_step_2 m hm (source_step_3 m hm)).1
  have source_step_7 : ∀ m : ℕ, 1 ≤ m → a (m + 1) + 1 = 4 * (a m + 1) / (a m + 2) := by
    intro m hm
    have hden : a m + 2 ≠ 0 := by
      have hp : 0 < a m := (source_step_3 m hm).1
      all_goals linarith
    all_goals rw [hrec m hm]
    field_simp [hden]
    all_goals ring
  have source_step_8 : ∀ m : ℕ, 1 ≤ m → b (m + 1) = b m / 4 := by
    intro m hm
    have hbnd := source_step_3 m hm
    have hden1 : a m + 1 ≠ 0 := by linarith [hbnd.1]
    have hden2 : a m + 2 ≠ 0 := by linarith [hbnd.1]
    have h6 := source_step_6 m hm
    have h7 := source_step_7 m hm
    change (2 - a (m + 1)) / (a (m + 1) + 1) = ((2 - a m) / (a m + 1)) / 4
    all_goals rw [h6, h7]
    field_simp [hden1, hden2]
    all_goals ring
  have source_step_9 : b 1 = (1 : ℝ) / 2 := by
    dsimp [b]
    all_goals rw [ha1]
    all_goals norm_num
  have hb_formula : ∀ k : ℕ, b (k + 1) = 2 / (4 : ℝ) ^ (k + 1) := by
    intro k
    induction k with
    | zero =>
        all_goals rw [show 0 + 1 = 1 by norm_num]
        all_goals rw [source_step_9]
        all_goals norm_num
    | succ k ih =>
        have hm : 1 ≤ k + 1 := by omega
        have h8 := source_step_8 (k + 1) hm
        have h8' : b (Nat.succ k + 1) = b (k + 1) / 4 := by
          simpa [Nat.succ_eq_add_one, Nat.add_assoc] using h8
        all_goals rw [h8', ih]
        have hexp : Nat.succ k + 1 = (k + 1) + 1 := by omega
        have hpow_succ : (4 : ℝ) ^ ((k + 1) + 1) = (4 : ℝ) ^ (k + 1) * 4 := by
          all_goals rw [pow_succ]
        all_goals rw [hexp, hpow_succ]
        have hpow : (4 : ℝ) ^ (k + 1) ≠ 0 := by positivity
        field_simp [hpow]
        all_goals ring
  have source_step_10 : ∀ m : ℕ, 1 ≤ m → b m = 2 / (4 : ℝ) ^ m := by
    intro m hm
    cases m with
    | zero => omega
    | succ k =>
        simpa [Nat.succ_eq_add_one] using hb_formula k
  have source_step_11 : ∀ m : ℕ, 1 ≤ m → (2 - a m) / (a m + 1) = 2 / (4 : ℝ) ^ m := by
    intro m hm
    have hb := source_step_10 m hm
    simpa [b] using hb
  have source_step_12 : ∀ m : ℕ, 1 ≤ m → (4 : ℝ) ^ m * (2 - a m) = 2 * (a m + 1) := by
    intro m hm
    have h := source_step_11 m hm
    have hden1 : a m + 1 ≠ 0 := by
      have hp := (source_step_3 m hm).1
      all_goals linarith
    have hpow : (4 : ℝ) ^ m ≠ 0 := by positivity
    calc
      (4 : ℝ) ^ m * (2 - a m)
          = ((2 - a m) / (a m + 1)) * ((a m + 1) * (4 : ℝ) ^ m) := by
              field_simp [hden1]
              all_goals ring
      _ = (2 / (4 : ℝ) ^ m) * ((a m + 1) * (4 : ℝ) ^ m) := by rw [h]
      _ = 2 * (a m + 1) := by
              field_simp [hpow]
              all_goals ring
  have source_step_13 : ∀ m : ℕ, 1 ≤ m → ((4 : ℝ) ^ m + 2) * a m = 2 * ((4 : ℝ) ^ m - 1) := by
    intro m hm
    have h := source_step_12 m hm
    all_goals nlinarith
  have source_step_14 : ∀ m : ℕ, 1 ≤ m → a m = (2 * ((4 : ℝ) ^ m - 1)) / (((4 : ℝ) ^ m) + 2) := by
    intro m hm
    have h13 := source_step_13 m hm
    have hden : ((4 : ℝ) ^ m + 2) ≠ 0 := by positivity
    all_goals rw [eq_div_iff hden]
    calc
      a m * ((4 : ℝ) ^ m + 2) = ((4 : ℝ) ^ m + 2) * a m := by ring
      _ = 2 * ((4 : ℝ) ^ m - 1) := h13
  have source_step_15 : a 1 = (2 * ((4 : ℝ) ^ 1 - 1)) / (((4 : ℝ) ^ 1) + 2) ∧ a 1 = 1 := by
    constructor
    · exact source_step_14 1 (by norm_num)
    · exact ha1
  exact source_step_14 n hn
